### Esteetika ja kunstifilosoofia

Groups: 3 · Skills: 11

[aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Aesthetic inquiry asks why experiences, works, and environments are judged beautiful, expressive, meaningful, or artistically valuable. Its focus is justification and concepts of value, not techniques of making art.

**User-friendly description (et):** Uuri, miks inimesed kogemusi ja kunstiteoseid ilusaks või väärtuslikuks peavad.

#### Esteetiline hinnang

Skills: 4

[aestheticJudgment.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt/aestheticJudgment/aestheticJudgment.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** An aesthetic evaluation can invoke perceptual qualities, interpretation, tradition, or standards that other observers may dispute.

**User-friendly description (et):** Uuri, kuidas esteetilisi arvamusi põhjendustega toetada.

[analyzeTheRoleOfContextInAestheticExperience.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt/aestheticJudgment/skills/analyzeTheRoleOfContextInAestheticExperience.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how setting, background knowledge, and cultural conventions can alter interpretation while the object remains unchanged.

**User-friendly description (et):** Uuri, kuidas olukord ja taustateadmised esteetilist kogemust muudavad.

##### Objektiivsete ja subjektiivsete ilukäsitluste võrdlus

[compareObjectiveAndSubjectiveAccountsOfBeauty.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt/aestheticJudgment/skills/compareObjectiveAndSubjectiveAccountsOfBeauty.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine whether aesthetic assessments can be reasoned about beyond individual preference without assuming universal consensus.

**User-friendly description (et):** Võrdle seisukohti, kas ilu saab hinnata ka väljaspool isiklikku maitset.

[distinguishAestheticFromInstrumentalValue.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt/aestheticJudgment/skills/distinguishAestheticFromInstrumentalValue.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why something may be appreciated for its appearance or experience rather than its practical usefulness.

**User-friendly description (et):** Erista asja ilu või väljendusväärtust selle praktilisest kasust.

##### Esteetilise hinnangu põhjendamine

[justifyAnAestheticJudgment.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/aestheticsAndPhilosophyOfArt/aestheticJudgment/skills/justifyAnAestheticJudgment.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Support an appraisal with relevant features and criteria rather than simply reporting that one likes or dislikes an object.

**User-friendly description (et):** Põhjenda esteetilist hinnangut asjakohaste tunnuste, mitte ainult isikliku maitsega.

### Epistemoloogia ja kriitiline hindamine

Groups: 4 · Skills: 19

[epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Questions about knowledge concern what can be believed responsibly, what makes claims true, and when confidence should change. This domain applies general standards of justification to testimony and public information; scientific experimental design has its own domain.

**User-friendly description (et):** Uuri, mis muudab uskumuse põhjendatuks ja kuidas hinnata avalikku teavet.

#### Tõendid ja tunnistused

Skills: 5

[evidenceAndTestimony.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/evidenceAndTestimony/evidenceAndTestimony.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Knowledge often depends on information supplied by other people or institutions. Source reliability, independence, and evidential fit require appraisal without treating every source as equally trustworthy.

**User-friendly description (et):** Õpi hindama teiste inimeste edastatud väiteid ja tõendeid.

##### Analüüsida episteemilist ebaõiglust

[analyzeEpistemicInjustice.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/evidenceAndTestimony/skills/analyzeEpistemicInjustice.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine how prejudicial credibility judgments or unequal interpretive resources can wrong someone in their capacity as a knower, distinct from warranted critical assessment of testimony.

**User-friendly description (et):** Uuri, kuidas ebaõiglased usaldusväärsuse hinnangud võivad takistada inimeste ärakuulamist.

##### Kontrollida kinnitust eri allikatest

[checkCorroborationAcrossSources.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/evidenceAndTestimony/skills/checkCorroborationAcrossSources.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine whether apparently agreeing accounts are genuinely independent or reproduce one underlying report.

**User-friendly description (et):** Kontrolli, kas mitu ühtivat allikat pakuvad tõesti sõltumatuid tõendeid.

##### Eristada väidet selle tõenditest

[distinguishAClaimFromItsEvidence.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/evidenceAndTestimony/skills/distinguishAClaimFromItsEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate what someone asserts from the observations, documents, or arguments presented to support it.

**User-friendly description (et):** Erista väidet ennast selle toetuseks toodud tõenditest.

##### Eristada otseseid tõendeid kuulujuttudest

[distinguishDirectEvidenceFromHearsay.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/evidenceAndTestimony/skills/distinguishDirectEvidenceFromHearsay.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize what a record or witness directly establishes and what depends on another person's retelling.

**User-friendly description (et):** Erista vahetuid ülestähendusi teiste vahendatud väidetest.

##### Hinnata tunnistuse usaldusväärsust

[evaluateTestimonialCredibility.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/evidenceAndTestimony/skills/evaluateTestimonialCredibility.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Consider the speaker's opportunity to know, relevant competence, track record, and possible conflicts without reducing evaluation to popularity.

**User-friendly description (et):** Hinda tunnistajat või eksperti tema asjakohase kogemuse ja võimalike huvide konfliktide järgi.

#### Teadmine ja põhjendamine

Skills: 5

[knowledgeAndJustification.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/knowledgeAndJustification/knowledgeAndJustification.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Belief, truth, evidence, and knowledge have distinct roles in epistemic evaluation. Competing theories of knowledge can disagree about exactly how those roles connect.

**User-friendly description (et):** Avasta, kuidas uskumused, tõde, tõendid ja teadmised on seotud, kuid erinevad.

##### Analüüsida matemaatilist tõestust põhjendusena

[analyzeMathematicalProofAsJustification.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/knowledgeAndJustification/skills/analyzeMathematicalProofAsJustification.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine why deductive proof has a distinctive epistemic role in mathematics, distinguishing formal derivability from experimental confirmation and acknowledging debates about proof's explanatory value.

**User-friendly description (et):** Uuri, miks matemaatiline tõestus erineb katsetest kogutud tõendusmaterjalist.

##### Võrrelda aprioorset ja empiirilist põhjendust

[compareAPrioriAndEmpiricalJustification.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/knowledgeAndJustification/skills/compareAPrioriAndEmpiricalJustification.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish support based primarily on reasoning from support requiring experience, without assuming the boundary is universally uncontested.

**User-friendly description (et):** Võrdle arutlusele tuginevat teadmist kogemusele tugineva teadmisega.

##### Eristada uskumust teadmisest

[distinguishBeliefFromKnowledge.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/knowledgeAndJustification/skills/distinguishBeliefFromKnowledge.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize that sincerely accepting a proposition does not by itself establish that it is known, even when the speaker is confident.

**User-friendly description (et):** Mõista, miks väite siiras uskumine ei tähenda automaatselt selle teadmist.

##### Eristada tõde põhjendusest

[distinguishTruthFromJustification.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/knowledgeAndJustification/skills/distinguishTruthFromJustification.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why a claim might be true for reasons its holder cannot supply, or well supported yet ultimately false.

**User-friendly description (et):** Erista väite tõesust ja häid põhjusi selle uskumiseks.

##### Hinnata uskumuse põhjendusi

[evaluateReasonsForABelief.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/knowledgeAndJustification/skills/evaluateReasonsForABelief.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine whether offered grounds actually bear on the proposition and withstand plausible objections.

**User-friendly description (et):** Kontrolli, kas esitatud põhjused tõesti toetavad uskumust.

#### Meedia ja avalik teave

Skills: 5

[mediaAndPublicInformation.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/mediaAndPublicInformation/mediaAndPublicInformation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Information environments combine reporting, interpretation, promotion, and falsehood. Epistemic evaluation concerns the warrant for public claims, not the psychological mechanics by which messages persuade audiences.

**User-friendly description (et):** Õpi uurima avalikult levitatavaid uudiseid, arvamusi ja väiteid.

##### Eristada väärinfot tahtliku pettuse süüdistusest

[distinguishMisinformationFromDeliberateDeceptionClaims.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/mediaAndPublicInformation/skills/distinguishMisinformationFromDeliberateDeceptionClaims.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify inaccurate information without asserting an author's intention to deceive unless independent evidence supports that inference.

**User-friendly description (et):** Tuvasta ebatäpseid väiteid, kuid ära eelda, et kõneleja tahtis petta.

##### Eristada uudisraportit arvamusest

[distinguishReportingFromOpinion.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/mediaAndPublicInformation/skills/distinguishReportingFromOpinion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify whether a passage presents checkable occurrences, interpretation, advocacy, or a mixture requiring separate evaluation.

[evaluateEvidenceBehindAHeadline.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/mediaAndPublicInformation/skills/evaluateEvidenceBehindAHeadline.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare a summary with the underlying article or evidence and identify claims that exceed what is documented.

##### Tuvastada tõendite eksitavat konteksti

[recognizeMisleadingContextInPresentedEvidence.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/mediaAndPublicInformation/skills/recognizeMisleadingContextInPresentedEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Detect how cropping, omitted baselines, selective examples, or missing dates can alter the apparent meaning of otherwise genuine material.

**User-friendly description (et):** Märka, kuidas puuduvad kuupäevad, kärbitud pildid või varjatud taust võivad eksitada.

##### Jõuda avaliku väite algallikani

[traceAPublicClaimToItsOriginalSource.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/epistemologyAndCriticalEvaluation/mediaAndPublicInformation/skills/traceAPublicClaimToItsOriginalSource.data.ts)

#### Ebakindlus ja skeptitsism

[ethicsAndMoralReasoning.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/ethicsAndMoralReasoning.data.ts)

#### Metaeetika

Skills: 6

[metaethics.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/ethicsAndMoralReasoning/metaethics/metaethics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Inquiry into the meaning, objectivity, and epistemic standing of moral discourse underlies but does not itself prescribe codes of conduct. Normative theories decide how to act; metaethical theories examine the status of such judgments.

**User-friendly description (et):** Uuri, mida moraalsed väited tähendavad ja kas moraalsed tõed sõltuvad isiklikest uskumustest.

##### Võrrelda moraalset realismi ja antirealismi

### Filosoofia ajalugu ja traditsioonid

Groups: 3 · Skills: 15

[historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Historically situated philosophical arguments develop through schools, intellectual movements, and traditions across cultures. Interpretation requires understanding both what a thinker argued and the debate that shaped the argument, without privileging one lineage as philosophy's default.

**User-friendly description (et):** Uuri eri kultuuride ja ajastute filosoofilisi ideid nende argumentide kaudu.

#### Filosoofilised traditsioonid

Skills: 8

[philosophicalTraditions.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/philosophicalTraditions/philosophicalTraditions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Intellectual traditions developed across many cultures through original arguments and sustained exchanges. Greek, Indian, Chinese, Islamic, African, Latin American, and particular Indigenous lineages are examined as philosophical sources in their own right, without treating a region as a single doctrine.

**User-friendly description (et):** Uuri eri kultuuritraditsioonides kujunenud filosoofilisi argumente.

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret a position in a specific Chinese philosophical lineage, such as Confucian or Daoist thinking, without conflating them.

**User-friendly description (et):** Tõlgenda Hiina traditsiooni väidet sellele omases kontekstis.

[analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromALatinAmericanTradition.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/philosophicalTraditions/skills/analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromALatinAmericanTradition.data.ts)

[analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromAnAfricanTradition.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/philosophicalTraditions/skills/analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromAnAfricanTradition.data.ts)

[analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromAnIslamicTradition.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/historyAndTraditionsOfPhilosophy/philosophicalTraditions/skills/analyzeAPhilosophicalArgumentFromAnIslamicTradition.data.ts)

### Loogika ja argumentatsioon

Groups: 6 · Skills: 35

[logicAndArgumentation.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/logicAndArgumentation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The central question is whether reasons support a conclusion and in what way. Formal entailment, defeasible inference, and argumentative defects are distinguished from psychological causes of belief, which belong chiefly to Psychology.

**User-friendly description (et):** Õpi hindama, kas põhjendused toetavad järeldust, ning ära tundma vigast arutluskäiku.

#### Arutlusvead

Skills: 6

[argumentativeFallacies.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/argumentativeFallacies/argumentativeFallacies.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A flaw concerns the relation between claims and reasons, not necessarily the speaker's motives or a named cognitive bias. Context matters: surface wording alone rarely proves fallaciousness.

**User-friendly description (et):** Õpi ära tundma levinud vigu väidete põhjendustes.

[detectAFalseDilemma.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/logicAndArgumentation/argumentativeFallacies/skills/detectAFalseDilemma.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Show where a position is distorted into an easier target and recover the actual view before evaluating it.

### Metafüüsika

Groups: 4 · Skills: 14

[metaphysics.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/metaphysics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Metaphysics examines the most general categories of reality, such as what exists, how things persist, and what makes events possible. Its conceptual questions differ from describing particular natural mechanisms in the sciences.

**User-friendly description (et):** Uuri filosoofilisi küsimusi olemasolu, samasuse, reaalsuse, aja ja võimalikkuse kohta.

#### Põhjuslikkus, aeg ja võimalikkus

Skills: 4

[causationTimeAndPossibility.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/causationTimeAndPossibility/causationTimeAndPossibility.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Metaphysical inquiry asks what causal dependence means and how temporal or modal claims relate beyond specific measurements.

**User-friendly description (et):** Uuri filosoofilisi mõtteid põhjustest, ajast ja sellest, mis oleks võinud juhtuda.

##### Võrrelda filosoofilisi ajakäsitlusi

[comparePhilosophicalAccountsOfTime.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/causationTimeAndPossibility/skills/comparePhilosophicalAccountsOfTime.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain differences between views that privilege the present and views treating past, present, and future as equally real.

**User-friendly description (et):** Võrdle vaadet, et ainult olevik on tõeline, vaatega, et kõik ajad on võrdselt tõelised.

[distinguishCausationFromTemporalSuccession.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/causationTimeAndPossibility/skills/distinguishCausationFromTemporalSuccession.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize that one event occurring before another does not itself establish a productive or counterfactual dependence.

**User-friendly description (et):** Varasem sündmus ei pruugi põhjustada hilisemat.

**Methodological description (English):** Identify claims that could be otherwise and those held to be true in every relevant possible circumstance.

**User-friendly description (et):** Erista seda, mis võib juhtuda, sellest, mis peab tingimata tõene olema.

##### Hinnata kontrafaktilist väidet

[evaluateACounterfactualClaim.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/metaphysics/causationTimeAndPossibility/skills/evaluateACounterfactualClaim.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine what would follow if specified conditions had differed while keeping relevant background assumptions coherent.

**User-friendly description (et):** Hinda, mis oleks võinud juhtuda kujuteldavates teistsugustes tingimustes.

### Vaim, mina ja inimese eksistents

This domain examines theories of mind, identity, agency, and existential commitments, distinguishing them from empirical mental-health claims.

**User-friendly description (et):** Uuri filosoofilisi küsimusi teadvuse, isikliku identiteedi, vabaduse ja elu mõtte kohta.

**User-friendly description (et):** Kaalu, millised tõendid võiksid toetada väidet tehislikust teadvusest.

##### Võrrelda vaimu ja keha suhte teooriaid

[compareTheoriesOfTheMindBodyRelation.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/mindAndConsciousness/skills/compareTheoriesOfTheMindBodyRelation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Contrast representative views such as physicalism and dualism by their commitments and explanatory challenges.

**User-friendly description (et):** Võrdle filosoofilisi seletusi vaimu ja keha seose kohta.

##### Eristada vaimseid ja füüsilisi kirjeldusi

[distinguishMentalFromPhysicalDescriptions.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/mindAndConsciousness/skills/distinguishMentalFromPhysicalDescriptions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify when a claim describes subjective experience, observable behavior, or bodily processes, and why they are not automatically equivalent.

**User-friendly description (et):** Erista tunnete kirjeldusi aju füüsiliste protsesside kirjeldustest.

##### Selgitada teiste vaimude probleemi

[explainTheProblemOfOtherMinds.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/mindAndConsciousness/skills/explainTheProblemOfOtherMinds.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe why another being's subjective experiences are not observed in the same way as one's own, and what kinds of inferences are used.

**User-friendly description (et):** Küsi, kuidas võime teada, kas teisel olendil on subjektiivseid kogemusi.

#### Isiklik identiteet

Skills: 4

[personalIdentity.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/personalIdentity/personalIdentity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The self may be characterized by bodily, psychological, narrative, or relational continuity. The question is what makes someone the same person, not how memory works empirically.

**User-friendly description (et):** Uuri, mis teeb inimesest sama isiku, hoolimata aja jooksul toimuvatest muutustest.

##### Analüüsida isikuks olemise kriteeriumi

[analyzeAPersonhoodCriterion.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/personalIdentity/skills/analyzeAPersonhoodCriterion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Test a proposed condition of being a person against borderline cases without assigning anyone lesser real-world dignity.

**User-friendly description (et):** Katseta isikuks olemise kriteeriume keeruliste juhtumite abil, eitamata inimväärikust.

##### Võrrelda kehalise ja psühholoogilise järjepidevuse käsitusi

[compareBodilyAndPsychologicalContinuityAccounts.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/personalIdentity/skills/compareBodilyAndPsychologicalContinuityAccounts.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess how different criteria handle change, memory loss, and hypothetical transfer scenarios.

**User-friendly description (et):** Võrdle kehalisi ja psühholoogilisi isikliku identiteedi käsitusi.

##### Eristada isiklikku identiteeti sarnasusest

[distinguishPersonalIdentityFromSimilarity.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/personalIdentity/skills/distinguishPersonalIdentityFromSimilarity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why sharing a personality or appearance is not enough to establish that two persons are numerically identical.

**User-friendly description (et):** Mõista, miks kaks sarnast inimest ei pruugi olla sama isik.

##### Hinnata mälu rolli isiklikus identiteedis

[evaluateTheRoleOfMemoryInPersonalIdentity.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/mindSelfAndHumanExistence/personalIdentity/skills/evaluateTheRoleOfMemoryInPersonalIdentity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine the philosophical significance and limitations of remembered experience as a criterion of persistence.

**User-friendly description (et):** Uuri, kas mälestustest piisab isikliku järjepidevuse tõendamiseks.

### Filosoofiline uurimine

Groups: 3 · Skills: 12

[philosophicalInquiry.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/philosophicalInquiry.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Philosophy investigates conceptual, normative, and foundational questions whose answers require reasons rather than observation alone. This domain concerns the practices used to formulate, refine, and discuss such questions; it is distinct from the formal evaluation of arguments in Logic.

**User-friendly description (et):** Uuri põhjendatud arutelus küsimusi tähenduse, väärtuste ja eelduste kohta.

#### Mõisteanalüüs

Skills: 4

[conceptualAnalysis.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/conceptualAnalysis/conceptualAnalysis.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Careful discussion depends on tracking the boundaries of concepts, especially when ordinary words cover multiple cases. These abilities refine meanings rather than merely memorize technical vocabulary.

**User-friendly description (et):** Uuri, kuidas selged määratlused ja hästi valitud näited parandavad filosoofilist mõtlemist.

##### Vaidlusaluse mõiste selgitamine

[clarifyAContestedConcept.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/conceptualAnalysis/skills/clarifyAContestedConcept.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Specify relevant conditions or uses of a term such as freedom so interlocutors can determine what their disagreement concerns.

**User-friendly description (et):** Selgita mõiste tähendust, kui inimesed selle kasutamises ei nõustu.

##### Tarvilike ja piisavate tingimuste eristamine

[distinguishNecessaryFromSufficientConditions.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/conceptualAnalysis/skills/distinguishNecessaryFromSufficientConditions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine whether a proposed property is required for a concept to apply, enough for it to apply, or both; a condition can fail one test and pass the other.

**User-friendly description (et):** Määra, kas tingimus on vajalik, piisav, mõlemat või kumbagi mitte.

##### Määratluse kontrollimine vastunäitega

[testADefinitionWithACounterexample.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/conceptualAnalysis/skills/testADefinitionWithACounterexample.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Find a case included or excluded incorrectly by a proposed definition and explain what the case reveals about its limits.

**User-friendly description (et):** Pane määratlus proovile, leides juhtumi, mida see valesti käsitleb.

##### Mõiste uurimine mõttekatsega

[useAThoughtExperimentToExamineAConcept.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/conceptualAnalysis/skills/useAThoughtExperimentToExamineAConcept.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Vary features of an imagined situation to isolate a philosophical principle; make clear which assumptions are stipulated rather than observed.

**User-friendly description (et):** Kasuta mõttelist olukorda idee proovimiseks, hoides eeldused selged.

#### Dialoog ja erimeelsused

Skills: 4

[dialogueAndDisagreement.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/dialogueAndDisagreement/dialogueAndDisagreement.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Reasoned dialogue seeks understanding and justified revision, not simply winning assent. Participants must fairly represent alternatives and keep interpersonal respect separate from agreement.

**User-friendly description (et):** Uuri, kuidas lugupidav eriarvamus aitab meil oma mõtteid ümber hinnata.

##### Süvendava filosoofilise küsimuse esitamine

[askAProbingPhilosophicalQuestion.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/dialogueAndDisagreement/skills/askAProbingPhilosophicalQuestion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Request a reason, distinction, implication, or counterexample that can advance inquiry without demanding personal disclosure.

**User-friendly description (et):** Esita küsimus, mis kontrollib teise inimese põhjendusi või selgitab tema seisukohta.

##### Teise inimese seisukoha õiglane esitamine

[reconstructAnotherPersonsPositionFairly.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/dialogueAndDisagreement/skills/reconstructAnotherPersonsPositionFairly.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Restate an interlocutor's strongest contextually plausible position accurately and charitably, rather than attacking a weaker caricature; fair reconstruction does not require overlooking genuine contradictions or unsupported claims.

**User-friendly description (et):** Esita teise inimese seisukoht täpselt, enne kui seda kritiseerid.

##### Filosoofilisele vastuväitele vastamine

[respondToAPhilosophicalObjection.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/dialogueAndDisagreement/skills/respondToAPhilosophicalObjection.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Address the actual challenge to a claim, rather than diverting to the objector's identity or motives.

**User-friendly description (et):** Vasta vastuväite sisule, mitte ära ründa selle esitajat.

##### Seisukoha muutmine põhjenduste valguses

[reviseAPositionInLightOfReasons.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/dialogueAndDisagreement/skills/reviseAPositionInLightOfReasons.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify which premise or conclusion should change when a cogent objection defeats an earlier commitment.

**User-friendly description (et):** Muuda uskumust või argumenti, kui tugevam põhjendus näitab, et see vajab parandamist.

#### Küsimused ja probleemid

Skills: 4

[questionsAndProblems.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/questionsAndProblems/questionsAndProblems.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A productive philosophical problem can be examined through competing answers, explicit concepts, and reasons. The object is to make a question discussable without assuming that every question has a single empirical test.

**User-friendly description (et):** Õpi muutma mõistatuslikke mõtteid küsimusteks, mida saab põhjalikult arutada.

##### Filosoofilise probleemi ja näite eristamine

[distinguishAPhilosophicalProblemFromAnExample.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/questionsAndProblems/skills/distinguishAPhilosophicalProblemFromAnExample.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate the general issue, such as whether promises create obligations, from the particular story used to make it vivid.

**User-friendly description (et):** Erista üldist filosoofilist probleemi seda illustreerivast loost.

##### Filosoofiliste ja empiiriliste küsimuste eristamine

[distinguishPhilosophicalQuestionsFromEmpiricalQuestions.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/questionsAndProblems/skills/distinguishPhilosophicalQuestionsFromEmpiricalQuestions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify when an issue asks what a concept means, what ought to be done, or what ultimately explains something, rather than only requesting a measurable fact; many questions have both aspects.

**User-friendly description (et):** Märka, kuidas filosoofilised küsimused erinevad neist, millele saab vastata mõõtmisega.

##### Filosoofilise küsimuse sõnastamine

[formulateAPhilosophicalQuestion.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/questionsAndProblems/skills/formulateAPhilosophicalQuestion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Turn an ordinary puzzlement into an open question about meaning, reasons, values, or assumptions that admits more than a yes-or-no preference.

**User-friendly description (et):** Esita avatud küsimus põhjuste, tähenduse või väärtuste, mitte pelga eelistuse kohta.

##### Filosoofilise probleemi eelduste tuvastamine

[identifyAssumptionsInAPhilosophicalProblem.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophicalInquiry/questionsAndProblems/skills/identifyAssumptionsInAPhilosophicalProblem.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Expose propositions that a question or proposed answer takes for granted, such as what counts as a person or what makes an action fair.

**User-friendly description (et):** Leia filosoofilise küsimuse või pakutud vastuse taga peituvad eeldused.

### Keelefilosoofia

Groups: 3 · Skills: 10

[philosophyOfLanguage.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/philosophyOfLanguage.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Language is examined as a system for conveying meaning, referring to the world, performing actions, and shaping interpretation. Grammar instruction and literary composition remain primarily in Language and Literature.

**User-friendly description (et):** Uuri, kuidas sõnad kannavad tähendust, osutavad asjadele ja kujundavad mõistmist.

#### Suhtlus ja tõlgendamine

Skills: 3

[communicationAndInterpretation.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/communicationAndInterpretation/communicationAndInterpretation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** What a speaker says can differ from what a speaker conveys or does by saying it. Interpretation must take context and plausible alternatives into account.

**User-friendly description (et):** Uuri, kuidas kontekst mõjutab seda, mida inimesed ütlevad ja edasi annavad.

##### Sõnasõnalise tähenduse ja vihje eristamine

[distinguishLiteralMeaningFromImplication.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/communicationAndInterpretation/skills/distinguishLiteralMeaningFromImplication.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify content explicitly expressed versus a reasonable conversational inference that could be cancelled or revised.

**User-friendly description (et):** Erista väite otsest tähendust sellest, millele see vihjab.

##### Kontekstipõhiste tõlgenduste hindamine

[evaluateContextualInterpretations.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/communicationAndInterpretation/skills/evaluateContextualInterpretations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare readings of an utterance using the speaker's context, conventions, and available evidence.

**User-friendly description (et):** Vali tõlgenduste vahel konteksti ja olemasolevate tõendite põhjal.

##### Kõneteo tuvastamine

[identifyASpeechAct.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/communicationAndInterpretation/skills/identifyASpeechAct.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize how an utterance functions as a promise, request, warning, or assertion beyond its sentence structure.

**User-friendly description (et):** Tunne ära, millal lausumine ise on tegu, näiteks lubamine või palumine.

#### Keel, tõde ja võim

Skills: 4

[languageTruthAndPower.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/languageTruthAndPower/languageTruthAndPower.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Descriptive categories, framing, and public speech influence which interpretations appear available. Evaluating their justification differs from explaining psychological persuasion.

**User-friendly description (et):** Uuri, kuidas keel väljendab hinnanguid ja kujundab avalikku arutelu.

##### Raamistusvaliku analüüs

[analyzeAFramingChoice.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/languageTruthAndPower/skills/analyzeAFramingChoice.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how alternate labels foreground different aspects of one issue and test what evidence each framing leaves out.

**User-friendly description (et):** Võrdle nimetusi, mis rõhutavad sama teema eri külgi.

##### Väite tõetingimuste analüüs

[analyzeATruthConditionalClaim.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/languageTruthAndPower/skills/analyzeATruthConditionalClaim.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify circumstances under which an assertion would count as true or false while recognizing context-dependent expressions.

**User-friendly description (et):** Tee kindlaks, millistel asjaoludel väide oleks tõene või väär.

##### Kirjeldava ja hinnangulise keele eristamine

[distinguishDescriptiveFromEvaluativeLanguage.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/languageTruthAndPower/skills/distinguishDescriptiveFromEvaluativeLanguage.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify how apparently factual wording can also express approval, disapproval, or a contested standard.

**User-friendly description (et):** Märka, millal näiliselt faktipõhine sõnastus väljendab ka hinnangut.

##### Keelelise kujutamise väite hindamine

[evaluateAClaimAboutLinguisticRepresentation.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/languageTruthAndPower/skills/evaluateAClaimAboutLinguisticRepresentation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess whether a label fairly describes people or phenomena without equating linguistic conventions with objective essences.

**User-friendly description (et):** Mõtle, kas inimeste ja asjade kirjeldused on õiglased ning tõendatud.

#### Tähendus ja osutus

Skills: 3

[meaningAndReference.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/meaningAndReference/meaningAndReference.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Words and sentences can express meanings beyond identifying objects; context, concepts, and the distinction between expression and referent affect analysis.

**User-friendly description (et):** Avasta sõna, selle tähenduse ja osutatud asja erinevus.

##### Sõna ja selle osutatu eristamine

[distinguishAWordFromItsReferent.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/meaningAndReference/skills/distinguishAWordFromItsReferent.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why a linguistic expression and the person, object, or kind it denotes are not identical.

**User-friendly description (et):** Erista sõna asjast või inimesest, keda see nimetab.

##### Mõtte ja osutuse eristamine

[distinguishSenseFromReference.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/meaningAndReference/skills/distinguishSenseFromReference.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze how different expressions can pick out the same entity while presenting it in different ways.

**User-friendly description (et):** Märka, kuidas erinevad väljendid võivad eri viisil osutada samale objektile.

##### Semantilise mitmetähenduslikkuse tuvastamine

[identifySemanticAmbiguity.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfLanguage/meaningAndReference/skills/identifySemanticAmbiguity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize when a sentence admits multiple readings due to a word or syntactic structure rather than simply lacking evidence.

**User-friendly description (et):** Leia lauseid, millel võib olla rohkem kui üks tähendus.

### Religioonifilosoofia

Groups: 3 · Skills: 15

[philosophyOfReligion.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/philosophyOfReligion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Reasoned inquiry into religious and nonreligious worldviews considers ultimate explanations, sources of belief, conceptions of divinity, and coexistence under pluralism. This domain evaluates arguments without prescribing worship, faith, atheism, or other personal commitments.

**User-friendly description (et):** Uuri usuliste ja mitteusuliste maailmavaadete argumente, surumata peale ühtegi uskumust.

#### Mitmekesisus ja tähendus

Skills: 3

[diversityAndMeaning.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/diversityAndMeaning/diversityAndMeaning.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Competing outlooks on religion, nonbelief, and life purpose raise interpretive and normative problems. Dialogue must distinguish a disagreement about truth from respect for people's freedom of conscience.

**User-friendly description (et):** Õpi lugupidavalt arutama erinevusi religioonis, mitteuskumises ja elu mõtte käsituses.

##### Analüüsida religioosset pluralismi filosoofilise probleemina

[analyzeReligiousPluralismAsAPhilosophicalProblem.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/diversityAndMeaning/skills/analyzeReligiousPluralismAsAPhilosophicalProblem.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare accounts of how conflicting ultimate-belief claims might be understood and evaluated while respecting freedom of conscience.

**User-friendly description (et):** Uuri filosoofilisi vastuseid omavahel konkureerivatele religioossetele tõeväidetele.

##### Analüüsida usulist sallivust eetilise põhimõttena

[analyzeReligiousToleranceAsAnEthicalPrinciple.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/diversityAndMeaning/skills/analyzeReligiousToleranceAsAnEthicalPrinciple.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine justifications and limits for respecting divergent religious or nonreligious commitments, distinguishing toleration from endorsement.

**User-friendly description (et):** Mõtle, miks ja mis piirides austada teistsuguste veendumustega inimesi.

##### Eristada religioosset skeptitsismi agnostitsismist

[distinguishReligiousSkepticismFromAgnosticism.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/diversityAndMeaning/skills/distinguishReligiousSkepticismFromAgnosticism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate withholding belief about particular religious claims from positions on the possibility of knowing whether divine reality exists.

**User-friendly description (et):** Erista kahtlusi usulistes väidetes ebakindlusest selle suhtes, mida saab teada.

#### Usk, mõistus ja kogemus

Skills: 4

[faithReasonAndExperience.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/faithReasonAndExperience/faithReasonAndExperience.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Different accounts of religious knowledge appeal to reasoning, testimony, revelation, or experience. Philosophical examination weighs what these sources can justify and remains distinct from taking part in a religious practice.

**User-friendly description (et):** Õpi, kuidas usku, arutlust ja kogemust kasutatakse religioossete väidete põhjendamiseks.

##### Võrrelda usku ja mõistust põhjenduse allikatena

[compareFaithAndReasonAsSourcesOfJustification.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/faithReasonAndExperience/skills/compareFaithAndReasonAsSourcesOfJustification.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analyze philosophical accounts in which faith and reasoning conflict, complement one another, or play different roles, without assuming one universal religious position.

**User-friendly description (et):** Võrdle arusaamu sellest, kuidas usk ja arutlus üksteist toetavad või kahtluse alla seavad.

##### Eristada filosoofilist uurimist religioossest praktikast

[distinguishPhilosophicalInquiryFromReligiousPractice.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/faithReasonAndExperience/skills/distinguishPhilosophicalInquiryFromReligiousPractice.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Separate reasoning about religious claims from performing rituals, accepting revelation, or participating in a tradition.

**User-friendly description (et):** Erista usuliste ideede arutamist usulistes tavades osalemisest.

##### Hinnata väidet teatatud ime kohta

[evaluateAReportedMiracleClaim.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/faithReasonAndExperience/skills/evaluateAReportedMiracleClaim.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Weigh testimony, background assumptions, and plausible alternative explanations when assessing an extraordinary event claim without prejudging its truth.

**User-friendly description (et):** Hinda erakordse sündmuse väidet, kaaludes tunnistusi ja alternatiivseid seletusi.

##### Hinnata usulist kogemust tõendina

[evaluateReligiousExperienceAsEvidence.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/faithReasonAndExperience/skills/evaluateReligiousExperienceAsEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess the possible warrant of reported transcendent experience, distinguishing the fact of having an experience from the explanation proposed for it.

**User-friendly description (et):** Uuri, kas isiklik usuline kogemus toetab laiemat väidet.

#### Ülim reaalsus ja jumalikkus

Skills: 8

[ultimateRealityAndDivinity.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/ultimateRealityAndDivinity/ultimateRealityAndDivinity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Religious and nonreligious accounts of ultimate reality include competing conceptions of divinity and nontheistic accounts of liberation or existence. Their arguments may invoke experience, explanation, definition, or objections, without settling a worldview by stipulation.

**User-friendly description (et):** Uuri argumente lõplike seletuste ja erinevate jumalikkuse käsituste kohta.

##### Analüüsida kosmoloogilist argumenti

[analyzeACosmologicalArgument.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/ultimateRealityAndDivinity/skills/analyzeACosmologicalArgument.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate reasoning from existence, dependence, contingency, or causation toward an ultimate explanation, including challenges to its assumptions.

**User-friendly description (et):** Hinda argumente, mis järeldavad sõltuvusest või põhjuslikkusest lõpliku põhjuse.

##### Analüüsida disainiargumenti

[analyzeADesignArgument.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/ultimateRealityAndDivinity/skills/analyzeADesignArgument.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine whether order or complexity supports an inference to a designer, considering the evidential relevance of natural alternatives.

**User-friendly description (et):** Kaalu, kas keerukus või kord on tõend arukast kavandamisest.

##### Analüüsida kurjuseargumenti

[analyzeAnArgumentFromEvil.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/ultimateRealityAndDivinity/skills/analyzeAnArgumentFromEvil.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how suffering and wrongdoing challenge particular accounts of divinity and assess the strengths of proposed philosophical responses.

**User-friendly description (et):** Hinda, kuidas kannatus seab kahtluse alla teatud jumalikkuse käsitused.

##### Analüüsida ontoloogilist argumenti

[analyzeAnOntologicalArgument.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/ultimateRealityAndDivinity/skills/analyzeAnOntologicalArgument.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate an a priori argument that moves from a proposed concept of God or maximal greatness toward existence, examining whether its logical premises and modal assumptions warrant the conclusion.

**User-friendly description (et):** Uuri argumente, mis püüavad tuletada jumaliku olemasolu definitsioonist.

##### Analüüsida mitteteistlikke religioosseid tegelikkuse käsitusi

[analyzeNontheisticReligiousAccountsOfReality.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/ultimateRealityAndDivinity/skills/analyzeNontheisticReligiousAccountsOfReality.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine how a particular nontheistic religious tradition understands reality, suffering, liberation, or ultimate truth without incorrectly treating absence of a creator deity as absence of religion.

[comparePhilosophicalConceptionsOfDivinity.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/ultimateRealityAndDivinity/skills/comparePhilosophicalConceptionsOfDivinity.data.ts)

##### Rekonstrueerida filosoofiline argument jumalikkuse kohta

[reconstructAPhilosophicalArgumentAboutDivinity.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfReligion/ultimateRealityAndDivinity/skills/reconstructAPhilosophicalArgumentAboutDivinity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify premises and conclusion in a theistic, atheistic, or agnostic argument without treating the position as settled by its name.

### Teadusfilosoofia

Groups: 4 · Skills: 26

[philosophyOfScience.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/philosophyOfScience.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Scientific inquiry is examined as a way of building, testing, and revising explanations. The focus is on general methodology and evidential justification; physics, biology, psychology, and other sciences own their domain-specific investigations.

**User-friendly description (et):** Uuri, kuidas teaduslikke väiteid kontrollitakse, toetatakse, muudetakse ja vaidlustatakse.

#### Tõendid ja põhjuslik järeldamine

Skills: 6

[evidenceAndCausalInference.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/evidenceAndCausalInference/evidenceAndCausalInference.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Observations become informative only through assumptions about measurement, variation, and alternative explanations. The quality of a causal conclusion is not identical to the size of an observed association.

**User-friendly description (et):** Uuri, mida tõendid võivad ja mida ei saa näidata põhjuslike seoste kohta.

##### Hinnata mõõtmise valiidsust

[assessMeasurementValidity.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/evidenceAndCausalInference/skills/assessMeasurementValidity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine whether an operational measure genuinely captures the construct a researcher claims to study.

**User-friendly description (et):** Kontrolli, kas mõõtmine tõesti mõõdab seda, mida väidab.

##### Hinnata valimi esinduslikkust

[assessSampleRepresentativeness.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/evidenceAndCausalInference/skills/assessSampleRepresentativeness.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine whether selection and coverage allow findings to extend to the population named in a conclusion.

**User-friendly description (et):** Kontrolli, kas valitud osalejad esindavad laiemat üldkogumit.

##### Eristada korrelatsiooni põhjuslikkusest

[distinguishCorrelationFromCausation.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/evidenceAndCausalInference/skills/distinguishCorrelationFromCausation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why two variables varying together does not alone show that changing one produces the other.

**User-friendly description (et):** Mõista, et kahe muutuja üheskoos muutumine ei tähenda põhjuslikku seost.

##### Hinnata uuringu põhjuslikku järeldust

[evaluateACausalConclusionFromAStudy.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/evidenceAndCausalInference/skills/evaluateACausalConclusionFromAStudy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Judge how design, alternative explanations, limitations, and observed evidence jointly support or weaken a causal claim.

**User-friendly description (et):** Hinda põhjuslikke väiteid uuringukava, tõendite ja võimalike muude selgituste põhjal.

[evaluateSamplingUncertainty.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/evidenceAndCausalInference/skills/evaluateSamplingUncertainty.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess how sample size, observed variation, and sampling processes affect the precision of an estimate, distinguishing imprecision from whether the sample represents its target population.

**User-friendly description (et):** Uuri, kuidas valimi valik ja varieeruvus mõjutavad hinnangu täpsust.

[identifyAConfoundingFactor.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/evidenceAndCausalInference/skills/identifyAConfoundingFactor.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Find a plausible third variable or selection process capable of producing an apparent relationship.

**User-friendly description (et):** Leia kolmas tegur, mis võiks seletada näilist seost.

Skills: 9

[experimentalDesign.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/experimentalDesign/experimentalDesign.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Controlled investigations attempt to isolate explanatory factors while managing confounding, expectations, and ethical constraints. Particular safeguards solve different problems and are not interchangeable.

**User-friendly description (et):** Uuri, kuidas uurimiskava aitab võrdlusi usaldusväärsemaks muuta.

##### Kontrollida asjakohaseid katsetingimusi

[controlRelevantExperimentalConditions.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/experimentalDesign/skills/controlRelevantExperimentalConditions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Hold relevant background conditions stable or account for them so comparisons are not undermined by extraneous differences.

**User-friendly description (et):** Hoia tähtsad tausttingimused võrreldavana, et võrdlus oleks õiglane.

[evaluateResearchEthics.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/experimentalDesign/skills/evaluateResearchEthics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess informed consent, voluntary participation, proportionality of risk, participant protection, and integrity of reporting in proposed research; distinguish ethical permissibility from whether a study can yield valid data.

**User-friendly description (et):** Kavandatavat uuringut hinnates arvesta nõusoleku, ohutuse ja ausa aruandlusega.

[explainAPlaceboControl.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/experimentalDesign/skills/explainAPlaceboControl.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (et):** Uuri, kuidas jaotuse varjamine nii osalejate kui ka uurijate eest võib vähendada kallutatust.

[explainRandomAssignment.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/experimentalDesign/skills/explainRandomAssignment.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Show how allocating participants or units by chance can reduce systematic pre-existing differences between comparison groups.

**User-friendly description (et):** Selgita, kuidas juhuslik rühmadesse jaotamine võib vähendada algseid erinevusi.

[explainSingleBlinding.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/experimentalDesign/skills/explainSingleBlinding.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify which party is kept unaware of assigned conditions and how that may reduce particular expectation-related effects.

**User-friendly description (et):** Mõista, kuidas tingimuse varjamine ühe osapoole eest võib vähendada ootuste mõju.

[explainThePurposeOfAControlGroup.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/experimentalDesign/skills/explainThePurposeOfAControlGroup.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify the comparison condition needed to interpret an intervention's effect where a control group is appropriate.

**User-friendly description (et):** Mõista, kuidas kontrollrühm aitab eristada sekkumise mõju.

[identifyADependentVariable.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/experimentalDesign/skills/identifyADependentVariable.data.ts)

##### Tuvastada sõltumatu muutuja

[identifyAnIndependentVariable.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/experimentalDesign/skills/identifyAnIndependentVariable.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize the hypothesized influence, manipulated factor, or explanatory predictor in a specified study, including designs where the researcher observes rather than sets its value.

**User-friendly description (et):** Leia tegur, mis oletatavasti mõjutab uuringu tulemust.

[questionsAndHypotheses.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/questionsAndHypotheses/questionsAndHypotheses.data.ts)

Skills: 6

[theoriesAndScientificPractice.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/theoriesAndScientificPractice/theoriesAndScientificPractice.data.ts)

[distinguishAScientificTheoryFromAHypothesis.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/philosophyOfScience/theoriesAndScientificPractice/skills/distinguishAScientificTheoryFromAHypothesis.data.ts)

### Sotsiaal- ja poliitikafilosoofia

Groups: 6 · Skills: 23

[socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy.data.ts)

It asks normative questions rather than describing the chronology of regimes or the mechanics of markets.

##### Poliitilise kohustuse käsitluste hindamine

[evaluateCompetingViewsOfPoliticalObligation.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/publicReasonAndCivicLife/skills/evaluateCompetingViewsOfPoliticalObligation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Consider when citizens may have moral reasons to obey, criticize, or resist laws irrespective of mere fear of punishment.

**User-friendly description (et):** Uuri, miks inimesed seadusi järgivad, vaidlustavad või neile vastu seisavad.

#### Õigused ja vabadus

Skills: 4

[rightsAndLiberty.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/rightsAndLiberty/rightsAndLiberty.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A right may protect a person's action, claim, or status and create obligations for others. Competing rights can require principled reconciliation.

**User-friendly description (et):** Uuri, milliseid õigusi inimesed võivad nõuda ja mida vabadus tähendab.

##### Õiguste konflikti analüüs

[analyzeAConflictBetweenRights.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/rightsAndLiberty/skills/analyzeAConflictBetweenRights.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify whose claims compete and evaluate justified limits without assuming one right automatically cancels all others.

**User-friendly description (et):** Mõtle, kuidas saaks lahendada oluliste õiguste vastuolusid.

##### Negatiivse ja positiivse vabaduse eristamine

[distinguishNegativeAndPositiveLiberty.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/rightsAndLiberty/skills/distinguishNegativeAndPositiveLiberty.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Contrast freedom from interference with capacities or opportunities to act, while recognizing debates about their relationship.

**User-friendly description (et):** Võrdle sekkumisvabadust suutlikkusega tõhusalt tegutseda.

##### Õiguste ja privileegide eristamine

[distinguishRightsFromPrivileges.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/rightsAndLiberty/skills/distinguishRightsFromPrivileges.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify whether a claim concerns an entitlement owed to a person or an advantage conditional on discretionary permission.

**User-friendly description (et):** Erista inimesele kuuluvat õigust tingimuslikult antud eelisest.

##### Südametunnistuse vabaduse selgitamine

[explainFreedomOfConscience.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/rightsAndLiberty/skills/explainFreedomOfConscience.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess why protecting personal belief and nonbelief may matter independently of agreement with any particular worldview.

**User-friendly description (et):** Uuri, miks inimestel peaks olema vabadus usulisteks või mitteusulisteks veendumusteks.

#### Tehnoloogia ja ühiskond

Skills: 3

[technologyAndSociety.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/technologyAndSociety/technologyAndSociety.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Technological artifacts and institutions shape the practical conditions of action, social change, and control. Philosophical analysis evaluates these mediation and agency claims rather than measuring product usage or engineering device performance.

**User-friendly description (et):** Õpi analüüsima, kuidas tehnoloogia mõjutab inimtegevust ja ühiskonda.

##### Inimautonoomia analüüs tehnoloogilistes süsteemides

[analyzeHumanAutonomyInTechnologicalSystems.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/technologyAndSociety/skills/analyzeHumanAutonomyInTechnologicalSystems.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate when reliance on automated or networked systems enhances or constrains meaningful choice and control, separate from the narrower ethics of individual algorithmic decisions.

**User-friendly description (et):** Uuri, millal tehnoloogia suurendab või vähendab inimese kontrolli oma otsuste üle.

##### Tehnoloogilise vahendamise analüüs

[analyzeTechnologicalMediation.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/technologyAndSociety/skills/analyzeTechnologicalMediation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Examine how a technological artifact changes the available actions, relationships, or choices through which people engage the world, without reducing the issue to the device's technical operation.

**User-friendly description (et):** Uuri, kuidas tehnoloogia muudab inimestele kättesaadavaid valikuid ja suhteid.

##### Tehnoloogilise determinismi hindamine

[evaluateTechnologicalDeterminism.data.ts](../../../content/philosophy/data/skills/socialAndPoliticalPhilosophy/technologyAndSociety/skills/evaluateTechnologicalDeterminism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess arguments that technological development determines social arrangements, including objections based on political choice, design, and historical contingency.

**User-friendly description (et):** Küsi, kas üksnes tehnoloogiline muutus määrab ühiskondade arengu.
